prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Spotlight Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen into a spotlight layout to highlight path options clearly.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight"}}
1: [sign_in, new_screen] Account Sync Benefits Screen: Insert a dedicated information screen before sign-in explaining how account creation protects pet data from resetting.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "new_account_benefits", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_account_benefits": {"headline": "Keep Your Pet Safe", "body": "Signing in backs up your pet memory and items to the cloud so your companion is never lost.", "layout": "card"}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Split Layout: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a split layout showing the pet preview alongside adoption details.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "split"}}
3: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Welcome Tour Flow: Add a new welcome tour step right after home_intro explaining how to interact, hide, and summon the pet on desktop.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_welcome_tour"], "home_intro": {"show_progress": true}, "new_welcome_tour": {"headline": "How to Interact With Your Pet", "body": "Click and drag your pet anywhere on screen. Use the system tray icon to open options or hide your companion.", "layout": "spotlight"}}
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Generation Progress Timer: Show a time estimate and helpful tips carousel on the waiting screen during pet generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Your pet is being prepared! You can position your companion anywhere on desktop when ready.", "style": "playful"}]}}
5: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Guidance Hint: Display a explicit hint under path options reassuring users they can change their choice in settings later.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Don't worry, you can switch or adjust your path preferences anytime later in app settings."}}
6: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Safe Restore Headline: Update the sign-in screen headline and body text to clarify that signing in protects save progress across logins.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Save & Secure Your Pet Progress", "body": "Connect an account so your companion settings and memory are safely saved to the cloud."}}
7: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Notification Opt-in: Add a desktop notification switch to the waiting screen so users get notified when generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Creating Your Desktop Pet", "body": "We'll notify you as soon as your companion is ready to appear on your desktop."}}
8: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Stage Layout: Switch the pick_friend screen to a stage layout to showcase pet options prominently.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage"}}
9: [finish, incentive] Home Intro Companion Bonus Badge: Add an early companion reward badge component to the home intro screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Early Companion Unlocked!", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Valid layout redesign of choose_path screen within onboarding.
Adding a new information screen within onboarding before sign_in is allowed.
Redesigning the adoption certificate layout is permitted as long as core functions remain.
Adding a new tour screen after home_intro is allowed under rule 4.
Time estimate on waiting screen represents a real wait and is permitted.
Adding reassurance copy to choose_path is allowed.
Updating sign_in copy within onboarding is permitted.
Adding a notification opt-in toggle to the waiting screen is permitted.
Redesigning the pick_friend layout within onboarding is allowed.
Onboarding copy cannot mention gifts, bonuses, or free extras ('Early Companion Unlocked!').
